item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 28/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be extremely hot over Guangdong today. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be more showers and a few squally thunderstorms over southern China today and tomorrow. With the upper-air disturbance departing, showers will ease off over the region in the latter part of this week. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea during the weekend to early next week. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will intensify gradually and bring very hot weather to southeastern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will edge closer slowly to Kyushu of Japan today and tomorrow. It will then recurve to the northeast and move across the western part of Japan.
